subjects.description: Connect commanded movement to what a robot actually does.

topics.title: Structures & materials
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Understand how loads, stiffness and material choices shape a robot.
topics.established: Rigid frames hold sensors and motors in repeatable positions.
topics.research: Compliant structures adapt to contact and distribute loads.
topics.question: How do you balance weight, strength, repairability and unpredictable impacts?
outcomes: Choose materials for mass and load
topics.exercise: Compare two beam cross-sections under the same load and explain the weight tradeoff.

topics.title: Mechanisms & drivetrains
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Explore gears, belts, joints and the trade between speed and force.
topics.established: Gears and linkages transform motion for wheels, arms and grippers.
topics.research: Soft and underactuated mechanisms use their physical design to simplify control.
topics.question: How can a mechanism remain efficient and reliable when its load changes?
outcomes: Relate gearing to speed and torque
topics.exercise: Design a drivetrain ratio for a target speed and incline.

topics.title: CAD & fabrication
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Move from an idea to parts that fit together.
topics.established: Parametric models and drawings make assemblies reproducible.
topics.research: Soft robotics explores molds and fabrication processes for compliant parts.
topics.question: How do tolerances and manufacturing choices change the behavior of the finished robot?
topics.exercise: Model a sensor bracket, dimension it, and check interference in an assembly.

topics.title: Circuits & power
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Understand the electrical path from a power source to a working robot.
topics.established: Regulators, motor drivers and protection circuits distribute power to different loads.
topics.research: Embedded robotics keeps pushing toward smaller systems with tighter power budgets.
topics.question: How do you keep measurements and computation stable when motors draw changing current?
outcomes: Budget current, voltage and battery energy
topics.exercise: Draw a fused low-voltage robot power diagram and calculate expected runtime.

topics.title: Microcontrollers & interfaces
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Explore the small computers that read sensors and command hardware.
topics.established: Microcontrollers handle sensor sampling, digital inputs and motor commands.
topics.research: micro-ROS connects constrained devices to larger robot software systems.
topics.question: How can a tiny device meet timing and memory constraints while communicating reliably?
outcomes: Connect peripherals over I²C, SPI and UART
topics.exercise: Read a sensor at a fixed interval and log missed deadlines.

topics.title: Sensors & measurement
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Discover what sensors report, what they miss and how to check their readings.
topics.established: Encoders, light sensors and inertial sensors measure different aspects of a robot and its surroundings.
topics.research: Robotics research combines imperfect measurements to estimate hidden states.
topics.question: How can a robot recognize a bad reading instead of confidently acting on it?
outcomes: Compare encoder, IMU and range sensing
topics.exercise: Calibrate a sensor against a reference and plot its residual error.

topics.title: Programming fundamentals
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Build the vocabulary to describe behavior in code.
topics.established: Functions, state and tests turn individual commands into repeatable behavior.
topics.research: Robotics software tools combine simulation and optimization with conventional programs.
topics.question: How do you make behavior understandable when many components run at once?
outcomes: Debug and test a small program
topics.exercise: Write a Python program that simulates a robot moving through a grid.

topics.title: Working with sensor data
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Make readings useful through arrays, visualization and uncertainty.
topics.established: Calibration, filtering and plotting reveal trends in noisy measurements.
topics.research: State estimation combines models with uncertain measurements.
topics.question: How much should you trust each sensor when measurements disagree?
topics.exercise: Plot a sensor log and compare raw data to a moving average.

topics.title: Robot software & communication
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Connect components with messages, timing and clear responsibilities.
topics.established: Message-based systems separate sensing, computation and action into components.
topics.research: Embedded integration and model-based tools connect hardware constraints to higher-level software.
topics.question: How can a system recover when a message arrives late or one component stops?
topics.exercise: Create a simulated publisher and controller, then record and replay their messages.

topics.title: Actuators & motor control
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Compare ways to turn electrical energy into controlled movement.
topics.established: Motor drivers and servo systems convert control signals into physical motion.
topics.research: Underactuated robotics studies movement with fewer independent controls than degrees of freedom.
topics.question: How do torque, speed, heat and power limits constrain the movement you can achieve?
topics.exercise: Model a motor’s speed response and choose gearing for a given load.

topics.title: Position & motion models
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Describe where a robot is and how its movement changes that position.
topics.established: Kinematic models relate wheel or joint motion to robot position.
topics.research: Optimization and contact-rich dynamics extend models to more complicated movement.
topics.question: How can a useful model account for slipping wheels and uncertain contact?
topics.exercise: Simulate a wheeled robot driving a square and explain why odometry drifts.

topics.title: Feedback & PID
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Use the gap between a target and a measurement to correct behavior.
topics.established: Feedback regulates motor speed, position and line-following behavior.
topics.research: Nonlinear and optimization-based control tackle dynamics beyond simple fixed-gain loops.
topics.question: How can a controller stay stable across delays, disturbances and changing loads?
outcomes: Tune proportional, integral and derivative terms
topics.exercise: Tune a simulated speed controller; plot overshoot and settling time for a load change.

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Algebra, trigonometry & units
topics.description: Rearrange equations and reason with units. Use vectors, angles, sine and cosine.
outcomes: Rearrange equations and reason with units
Use vectors, angles, sine and cosine
Read graphs and estimate orders of magnitude
topics.exercise: Calculate wheel travel from radius and rotation; check the result in meters.
topics.established: Geometry converts wheel rotations into distance.
topics.research: These foundations support geometric robot models.
topics.question: When is a simple geometric model accurate enough?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Forces, energy & motion
topics.description: Draw free-body diagrams. Connect force, torque, work and energy.
outcomes: Connect force, torque, work and energy
topics.exercise: Estimate the torque needed to move a cart up a ramp and state your assumptions.
topics.established: Force and energy estimates guide motor sizing.
topics.research: Contact and friction remain important sources of modeling uncertainty.
topics.question: How well can a friction model predict a changing surface?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Calculus
topics.description: Differentiate position to obtain velocity. Integrate velocity to recover displacement.
outcomes: Use series to approximate nonlinear functions
topics.exercise: Compare analytic and numerical velocity for a simulated wheel trajectory.
topics.established: Calculus describes changing motion.
topics.research: Numerical approximations trade computation against accuracy.
topics.question: How does approximation error accumulate over time?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Linear algebra
topics.description: Solve systems with matrices. Work with bases, eigenvectors and singular values.
outcomes: Work with bases, eigenvectors and singular values
Use least squares for noisy measurements
topics.exercise: Fit a line to noisy range measurements and inspect the residuals.
topics.established: Matrices encode rotations and solve estimation problems.
topics.research: Large estimation systems depend on efficient numerical linear algebra.
topics.question: How can you detect an ill-conditioned estimate?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Multivariable & vector calculus
topics.description: Compute gradients and Jacobians. Apply the multivariable chain rule.
topics.exercise: Differentiate a two-joint arm’s endpoint coordinates and verify with finite differences.
topics.established: Jacobians connect joint motion to endpoint motion.
topics.research: Differentiable models allow optimization through complex systems.
topics.question: Where do useful derivatives fail at contact transitions?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Differential equations
topics.description: Solve first- and second-order dynamics. Interpret eigenvalues and transients.
outcomes: Simulate a state evolving over time
topics.exercise: Simulate a spring–mass–damper and compare numerical and analytic responses.
topics.established: Differential equations predict mechanical and electrical transients.
topics.research: Nonlinear dynamics reveal behavior beyond linear approximations.
topics.question: When does a local approximation stop predicting the motion?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Probability & statistics
topics.description: Apply conditional probability and Bayes’ rule. Describe covariance and random variables.
outcomes: Apply conditional probability and Bayes’ rule
topics.exercise: Estimate sensor bias and noise from repeated measurements; report uncertainty.
topics.established: Probability quantifies measurement uncertainty.
topics.research: Statistical models must contend with data that differs from training conditions.
topics.question: How can you detect when uncertainty estimates are overconfident?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Numerical methods & optimization
topics.description: Solve least-squares and constrained problems. Use gradients and numerical integration.
topics.exercise: Optimize a smooth path around an obstacle and compare several initial guesses.
topics.established: Optimization fits models and computes feasible trajectories.
topics.research: Real-time nonlinear solvers support increasingly complex robot behavior.
topics.question: How do you trade solution quality against a hard time limit?

topics.subject: mathematics-physics
topics.title: Discrete mathematics & logic
topics.description: Use sets, logic and proof by induction. Model relationships with graphs.
outcomes: Use sets, logic and proof by induction
Count possibilities and reason about complexity
topics.exercise: Represent rooms as a graph and explain why breadth-first search finds a shortest unweighted path.
topics.established: Graphs represent routes and symbolic task states.
topics.research: Combinatorial planning scales poorly as choices grow.
topics.question: What useful structure can reduce a planning search?

topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.title: Rigid-body dynamics
topics.description: Use inertia, momentum and energy. Derive Newton–Euler or Lagrange equations.
topics.exercise: Derive and simulate a pendulum, then compare two mass distributions.
topics.established: Dynamics predicts the torques needed to accelerate robot links.
topics.research: Contact-rich dynamics couples smooth motion with discrete impacts.
topics.question: Which physical effects must a model retain to predict a task?

topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.title: Compliance & soft mechanisms
topics.description: Explain passive and active compliance. Compare soft and rigid grippers.
topics.exercise: Design a compliant gripper concept and specify a test for its force–displacement response.
topics.established: Compliance helps accommodate shape and alignment errors.
topics.research: Soft bodies and tactile sensing extend contact-rich manipulation.
topics.question: How can a deformable robot estimate its own shape?

topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.title: Signals, sampling & filtering
topics.description: Interpret frequency spectra and transfer functions. Explain aliasing and sample rate selection.
outcomes: Interpret frequency spectra and transfer functions
Explain aliasing and sample rate selection
topics.exercise: Sample a sinusoid below and above the Nyquist rate and demonstrate aliasing.
topics.established: Filtering suppresses noise while changing signal delay.
topics.research: Perception and feedback must balance filtering with latency.
topics.question: How much delay can a controller tolerate?

topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.title: Embedded & real-time systems
topics.description: Schedule work within timing budgets. Reason about concurrency and watchdogs.
topics.exercise: Simulate a control loop with delayed messages and test a watchdog response.
topics.established: Embedded systems enforce predictable sensing and actuation timing.
topics.research: Distributed robot software must maintain timing across multiple processors.
topics.question: What happens when a safety-critical message arrives late?

topics.subject: programming
topics.title: Algorithms & data structures
topics.description: Choose queues, heaps, trees and graphs. Analyze runtime and memory growth.
outcomes: Choose queues, heaps, trees and graphs
topics.exercise: Compare Dijkstra’s algorithm and A* on the same grid and count expanded states.
topics.established: Efficient data structures make planning tractable.
topics.research: Large search spaces motivate approximation and problem-specific heuristics.
topics.question: When is an approximate answer good enough?

topics.subject: programming
topics.title: Linux, C++ & software engineering
topics.description: Use Linux, Git and automated tests. Understand compiled code, ownership and memory.
outcomes: Use Linux, Git and automated tests
Understand compiled code, ownership and memory
Debug interfaces and document reproducible builds
topics.exercise: Package a small Python or C++ robot model with tests and reproducible setup instructions.
topics.established: Robot teams depend on versioned, tested software interfaces.
topics.research: Reliable distributed software needs observability and reproducibility.
topics.question: How can a failure be reproduced from a field log?

topics.subject: programming
topics.title: Robot modeling & simulation
topics.description: Describe links and joints in a robot model. Configure collision, contact and sensor models.
outcomes: Describe links and joints in a robot model
Configure collision, contact and sensor models
topics.exercise: Create a simulated two-link arm and measure how time step changes its behavior.
topics.established: Simulation supports development before hardware integration.
topics.research: Contact modeling and model calibration remain central to transfer.
topics.question: Which simulator errors matter for the intended task?

topics.subject: motion-control
topics.title: Forward & inverse kinematics
topics.description: Compose 3D transforms and rotations. Solve forward and inverse kinematics.
topics.exercise: Compute the reachable workspace of a two-link arm and identify singular configurations.
topics.established: Kinematics converts end-effector goals to joint configurations.
topics.research: Constrained inverse kinematics handles redundant robots and obstacles.
topics.question: How should a robot choose among many valid joint configurations?

topics.subject: motion-control
topics.title: Linear systems & state-space control
topics.description: Analyze stability and frequency response. Check controllability and observability.
outcomes: Design state feedback and an observer
topics.exercise: Stabilize a linearized inverted pendulum and measure robustness to parameter error.
topics.established: Linear feedback regulates systems around operating points.
topics.research: Model-based design must account for unmodeled dynamics.
topics.question: How far from the operating point is the design still useful?

topics.subject: motion-control
topics.title: System identification
topics.description: Design informative input experiments. Fit dynamic model parameters.
outcomes: Validate a model on held-out trajectories
topics.exercise: Identify a motor model from simulated input-output data and test it on a different command.
topics.established: Identified models improve controller tuning.
topics.research: Data-driven models trade expressive power against interpretability.
topics.question: How can a robot learn dynamics without unsafe experiments?

topics.subject: motion-control
topics.title: Optimal control & MPC
topics.description: Derive an LQR controller. Formulate finite-horizon trajectory optimization.
outcomes: Use model predictive control with constraints
topics.exercise: Compare PID and constrained MPC on the same simulated tracking problem.
topics.established: Optimal control balances competing costs under dynamics.
topics.research: Fast trajectory optimization supports agile movement.
topics.question: Can a controller stay feasible when its model is wrong?

topics.subject: motion-control
topics.title: Nonlinear & robust control
topics.description: Analyze Lyapunov stability. Reason about uncertainty and robustness.
outcomes: Study hybrid dynamics and contact modes
topics.exercise: Construct a Lyapunov argument for a simple nonlinear system and test its region of attraction.
topics.established: Nonlinear methods address behavior beyond a single operating point.
topics.research: Verification seeks guarantees for complex physical systems.
topics.question: Which guarantees survive unmodeled impacts and delays?

topics.subject: perception-estimation
topics.title: Image processing & computer vision
topics.description: Apply image filtering and feature extraction. Understand camera projection.
outcomes: Apply image filtering and feature extraction
Calibrate a camera and quantify reprojection error
topics.exercise: Calibrate a virtual or physical camera and compare estimated intrinsics to a reference.
topics.established: Vision provides measurements of objects and scene geometry.
topics.research: Learned representations complement geometric methods.
topics.question: How can perception remain reliable under changing light and texture?

topics.subject: perception-estimation
topics.title: State estimation & sensor fusion
topics.description: Implement Bayesian predict-update steps. Apply Kalman and extended Kalman filters.
outcomes: Apply Kalman and extended Kalman filters
topics.exercise: Fuse noisy wheel and position measurements; compare estimated error to reported covariance.
topics.established: Sensor fusion improves robot state estimates.
topics.research: Factor graphs combine many measurements across time.
topics.question: How can a robot detect a confidently wrong estimate?

topics.subject: perception-estimation
topics.title: 3D vision & point clouds
topics.description: Recover geometry with stereo or depth. Register point clouds and estimate pose.
outcomes: Recover geometry with stereo or depth
Register point clouds and estimate pose
topics.exercise: Align two synthetic point clouds with ICP and show a case where it fails.
topics.established: Depth data supports obstacle detection and object pose estimation.
topics.research: Partial observations challenge geometric reconstruction.
topics.question: How much geometry can be inferred from an incomplete view?

topics.subject: perception-estimation
topics.title: Localization & SLAM
topics.description: Build occupancy and landmark maps. Connect odometry, loop closure and graph optimization.
outcomes: Connect odometry, loop closure and graph optimization
topics.exercise: Compare dead reckoning and landmark-based localization in a simulated loop.
topics.established: Mapping and localization support autonomous navigation.
topics.research: Long-term mapping must handle changes and ambiguous revisits.
topics.question: When should a robot trust a loop closure?

topics.subject: perception-estimation
topics.title: Visual-inertial & semantic perception
topics.description: Combine visual and inertial constraints. Connect semantic and geometric maps.
topics.exercise: Design a visual-inertial evaluation with motion blur, missing frames and uncertainty metrics.
topics.established: Multiple sensing modalities help reconstruct motion and scene structure.
topics.research: Semantic understanding extends geometry to task-relevant meaning.
topics.question: How should conflicting geometry and semantics be reconciled?

topics.subject: planning-navigation
topics.title: Search & motion planning
topics.description: Represent configuration spaces and collisions. Compare graph search, RRT and PRM.
outcomes: Compare graph search, RRT and PRM
Distinguish a path from a time-parameterized trajectory
topics.exercise: Plan a collision-free route for a planar arm and check the swept motion between samples.
topics.established: Motion planners find feasible paths around obstacles.
topics.research: High-dimensional and changing environments challenge planning efficiency.
topics.question: How do you certify that an interpolated path is collision-free?

topics.subject: planning-navigation
topics.title: Autonomous navigation
topics.description: Connect mapping, localization and planning. Use costmaps and local obstacle avoidance.
outcomes: Use costmaps and local obstacle avoidance
topics.exercise: Navigate a simulated robot through a mapped space and introduce a blocked corridor.
topics.established: Navigation stacks connect global goals with local feedback.
topics.research: Changing environments require recovery from perception and planning failures.
topics.question: When should a robot stop, replan or ask for help?

topics.subject: planning-navigation
topics.title: Task planning & decision-making
topics.description: Build state machines and behavior trees. Model actions with preconditions and effects.
outcomes: Build state machines and behavior trees
Model actions with preconditions and effects
topics.exercise: Implement a pick-and-place task with explicit recovery for a failed grasp.
topics.established: Task-level logic sequences robot skills.
topics.research: Task and motion planning couples symbolic goals to physical feasibility.
topics.question: How should a planner reason about an action that might fail?

topics.subject: planning-navigation
topics.title: Planning under uncertainty
topics.description: Model MDPs and POMDPs. Reason about belief states and information gain.
outcomes: Reason about belief states and information gain
Balance exploration, risk and task reward
topics.exercise: Compare a direct route to a longer route with better localization landmarks.
topics.established: Belief-space reasoning accounts for uncertainty in action selection.
topics.research: Information gathering can be part of the control objective.
topics.question: When is it worth moving just to see better?

topics.subject: planning-navigation
topics.title: Multi-robot coordination
topics.description: Allocate tasks across robots. Avoid conflicts in shared space.
topics.exercise: Schedule three simulated robots through a shared intersection and test communication loss.
topics.established: Robot fleets coordinate shared workspaces and resources.
topics.research: Decentralized planning must handle partial information and changing membership.
topics.question: How can a fleet coordinate when communication is unreliable?

topics.subject: robot-learning
topics.title: Machine learning foundations
topics.description: Train regression and classification models. Separate training, validation and test data.
outcomes: Separate training, validation and test data
topics.exercise: Predict a robot’s energy use from synthetic logs and compare against a constant baseline.
topics.established: Learned models predict quantities that are difficult to model explicitly.
topics.research: Distribution shift makes deployment harder than benchmark evaluation.
topics.question: How can a model recognize inputs it has not learned to handle?

topics.subject: robot-learning
topics.title: Deep learning & representations
topics.description: Explain backpropagation and optimization. Train neural visual representations.
topics.exercise: Train a small image classifier and evaluate it under a lighting change.
topics.established: Deep networks turn high-dimensional observations into usable features.
topics.research: Representation learning seeks features that transfer across tasks.
topics.question: Which parts of a learned representation transfer to a new robot?

topics.subject: robot-learning
topics.title: Reinforcement learning
topics.description: Formulate states, actions and rewards. Compare value and policy methods.
outcomes: Evaluate sample efficiency and reward exploitation
topics.exercise: Train a simulated control policy across several seeds and compare it with a classical controller.
topics.established: Reinforcement learning optimizes behavior through interaction.
topics.research: Reliable transfer and efficient exploration remain research challenges.
topics.question: How can a policy learn without exploiting a simulator artifact?

topics.subject: robot-learning
topics.title: Imitation & generalist robot policies
topics.description: Learn behavior from demonstrations. Analyze covariate shift and dataset coverage.
outcomes: Analyze covariate shift and dataset coverage
topics.exercise: Train behavior cloning on a simulated reaching task and test perturbed starting states.
topics.established: Demonstrations provide examples of useful robot behavior.
topics.research: Broader policies aim to connect perception, language and diverse actions.
topics.question: How can a robot recognize when a demonstration does not cover the situation?

topics.subject: robot-learning
topics.title: Sim-to-real & adaptation
topics.description: Identify the reality gap. Compare domain randomization and adaptation.
outcomes: Design transfer tests with held-out conditions
topics.exercise: Vary friction, mass and sensing delay in simulation and measure policy sensitivity.
topics.established: Model calibration and variation tests expose brittle behavior.
topics.research: Transfer methods seek performance across different dynamics and environments.
topics.question: Which simulated variations predict real-world failures?

topics.subject: human-systems
topics.title: Human–robot interaction
topics.description: Translate human needs into interaction requirements. Design understandable robot behavior.
outcomes: Translate human needs into interaction requirements
topics.exercise: Prototype a robot status interface and define a small, consent-based usability study.
topics.established: Interaction design helps people understand and direct robot behavior.
topics.research: Human–robot teams must coordinate intent and responsibility.
topics.question: How should a robot communicate uncertainty without overwhelming its user?

topics.subject: human-systems
topics.title: Safety, ethics & societal impact
topics.description: Identify hazards and reduce exposure. Reason about privacy, accessibility and responsibility.
outcomes: Reason about privacy, accessibility and responsibility
Distinguish a demo from evidence of safe operation
topics.exercise: Write a hazard log for a tabletop robot, including stop behavior and test boundaries.
topics.established: Risk assessment and human-centered design inform responsible engineering.
topics.research: Trustworthy autonomy requires evidence about people and deployment conditions.
topics.question: Who bears the cost when an autonomous system fails?

topics.subject: human-systems
topics.title: Systems engineering & deployment
topics.description: Turn needs into measurable requirements. Budget power, latency, compute and cost.
outcomes: Budget power, latency, compute and cost
Plan integration, maintenance and acceptance tests
topics.exercise: Create an interface contract and verification matrix for an autonomous delivery robot.
topics.established: Systems engineering aligns components with a complete operational objective.
topics.research: Robust field deployments must handle failures across component boundaries.
topics.question: How can component-level evidence support a system-level claim?

topics.subject: human-systems
topics.title: Verification & dependable autonomy
topics.description: Distinguish verification from validation. Design fault injection and boundary tests.
outcomes: Design fault injection and boundary tests
Understand runtime monitoring and formal guarantees
topics.exercise: Inject stale sensor data and actuator saturation into a simulated robot and verify its fallback behavior.
topics.established: Testing and monitoring find faults before and during operation.
topics.research: Formal methods investigate guarantees for hybrid robot behavior.
topics.question: What can be guaranteed when perception remains uncertain?

topics.subject: human-systems
topics.title: Haptics & teleoperation
topics.description: Connect human input to remote motion. Reason about feedback, impedance and delay.
outcomes: Connect human input to remote motion
Reason about feedback, impedance and delay
topics.exercise: Simulate delayed teleoperation and compare direct control with constrained assistance.
topics.established: Teleoperation lets people guide robots in remote or difficult tasks.
topics.research: Shared autonomy combines human intent with local robot intelligence.
topics.question: How should control authority shift between a person and a robot?

topics.subject: robot-platforms
topics.title: Manipulation & grasping
topics.description: Analyze grasps, friction cones and force closure. Plan reaching and grasp transitions.
outcomes: Analyze grasps, friction cones and force closure
Compare position, force and impedance control
topics.exercise: Simulate pick-and-place with several object poses and report success and failure modes.
topics.established: Robot arms perform structured handling and assembly.
topics.research: Dexterous manipulation studies contact changes and uncertain objects.
topics.question: How can a robot manipulate an object it has never seen?

topics.subject: robot-platforms
topics.title: Legged robots & humanoids
topics.description: Model balance and support contacts. Reason about gaits and hybrid dynamics.
outcomes: Reason about gaits and hybrid dynamics
Plan whole-body motion under contact constraints
topics.exercise: Simulate a hopping model and test recovery from a disturbance.
topics.established: Legged robots coordinate balance with changing ground contact.
topics.research: Whole-body control seeks agile movement on uncertain terrain.
topics.question: How can a robot recover when a foothold moves?

topics.subject: robot-platforms
topics.title: Aerial robotics
topics.description: Explain thrust, attitude and multirotor dynamics. Connect estimation to flight control.
outcomes: Explain thrust, attitude and multirotor dynamics
topics.exercise: Use a flight simulator to test waypoint tracking under wind and delayed position updates.
topics.established: Autopilots combine estimation and feedback for controlled flight.
topics.research: Agile flight requires perception and control under tight resource constraints.
topics.question: How can a vehicle navigate when position sensing is unreliable?

topics.subject: robot-platforms
topics.title: Field, underwater & space robots
topics.description: Compare terrain, buoyancy and communication constraints. Design for limited energy and recovery access.
outcomes: Compare terrain, buoyancy and communication constraints
Design for limited energy and recovery access
topics.exercise: Compare requirements for the same inspection mission on land, underwater and in space.
topics.established: Field robots operate beyond structured indoor workspaces.
topics.research: Long-duration autonomy must manage uncertainty and limited intervention.
topics.question: How should a robot decide whether it can safely return?

topics.subject: robot-platforms
topics.title: Medical & assistive robotics
topics.description: Connect human biomechanics to robot requirements. Study rehabilitation, prosthetics and surgical interfaces.
outcomes: Connect human biomechanics to robot requirements
Study rehabilitation, prosthetics and surgical interfaces
Distinguish engineering evaluation from clinical evidence
topics.exercise: Write a simulation-only assistive-device study plan with user needs, constraints and evaluation measures.
topics.established: Assistive robots couple mechanical function with individual human needs.
topics.research: Adaptive assistance investigates how support should change over time.
topics.question: How can assistance adapt without reducing a person’s agency?

topics.subject: research-practice
topics.title: Experiments & technical communication
topics.description: State a testable hypothesis. Use controls, repetitions and uncertainty.
topics.exercise: Compare two sensor filters with repeated trials, plots and a documented dataset.
topics.established: Repeatable experiments turn observations into usable evidence.
topics.research: Open data and reproducible tools help test claims across settings.
topics.question: Could another team reproduce the conclusion from the report?

topics.subject: research-practice
topics.title: Integrated robotics capstone
topics.description: Integrate sensing, planning and feedback. Manage interfaces and staged acceptance tests.
outcomes: Manage interfaces and staged acceptance tests
Present measured performance and failure analysis
topics.exercise: Build a simulated autonomous mission; deliver code, architecture, evaluation logs and a demonstration.
topics.established: Capstones expose interface and integration problems absent from isolated exercises.
topics.research: Field-ready autonomy needs evaluation beyond successful demonstrations.
topics.question: Which failure would a polished demonstration conceal?

topics.subject: research-practice
topics.title: Reading & reproducing research
topics.description: Read claims, assumptions and experimental evidence. Reproduce a baseline and run ablations.
outcomes: Read claims, assumptions and experimental evidence
Reproduce a baseline and run ablations
topics.exercise: Reproduce one result from a paper in your chosen track and explain any discrepancy.
topics.established: Replication distinguishes an idea from the conditions needed for it to work.
topics.research: Research advances through comparisons, negative results and revised hypotheses.
topics.question: What evidence would change your belief in the proposed method?

topics.subject: research-practice
topics.title: Master’s thesis or systems project
topics.description: Define a research question or engineering requirement. Conduct a sustained investigation with a defensible evaluation.
outcomes: Define a research question or engineering requirement
Conduct a sustained investigation with a defensible evaluation
Communicate contributions, limitations and next steps
topics.exercise: Produce a thesis or project report with a baseline, reproducible artifacts, quantitative results and an oral defense.
topics.established: A graduate project demonstrates independent technical judgment.
topics.research: Research degrees may emphasize new knowledge; professional programs may emphasize complete systems.
topics.question: What does your work establish that the baseline did not?
